src: ; 04 reduction_shared — block-wide sum with shared memory and __syncthreads()
;   __global__ void reduce(const int* in, int* out) {
; A block of 32 threads is 4 warps. BAR parks each warp until all 4 arrive,
; so no warp reads a partial sum that another warp has not written yet.
.dump OUT, 4, per-block sums (block b = sum of 32b+1 .. 32b+32)
MAD   R3, R1, R2, R0        ; global index
SETP.LT P0, R0, R6          ; active = t < stride   (predication, no branch)
@P1 BRA   loop                  ; uniform branch: every lane agrees
